The only ArcGIS layer found under the county name (HenryCoZoning, services5.arcgis.com/SRuaqVyoD8TEQJga, layer 19) is a land use layer (LUCODE/DRAWCODE, 265 features), not zoning districts, and the ArcGIS 'Henry County Zoning Map' items found are for Henry County, Ohio.
